test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Change the following sentence into the Active form.**

Why had the highly sensitive company report been rejected by the board of directors?

options.text: Why had the board of directors rejected the highly sensitive company report?
Why the board of directors had rejected the highly sensitive company report?
The board of directors had rejected the highly sensitive company report, why?
Why did the board of directors reject the highly sensitive company report?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• Active voice structure: The subject of the sentence performs the action on the object.
 
• In the given passive sentence: "Why had the highly sensitive company report been rejected by the board of directors?"
 
• To convert this into active voice, the subject "the board of directors" must perform the action "rejected" on the object "the highly sensitive company report."
 
• The correct active voice sentence is: "Why had the board of directors rejected the highly sensitive company report?"

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"Why had the board of directors rejected the highly sensitive company report?"*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Why the board of directors had rejected the highly sensitive company report?" – Incorrect word order.
 
• **Option 3: **"The board of directors had rejected the highly sensitive company report, why?" – Incorrect structure and punctuation.
 
• **Option 4: **"Why did the board of directors reject the highly sensitive company report?" – Incorrect tense (simple past instead of past perfect).
